_about: 4-01 (level0c) GOLD route, the owner's own gold run of the original (video 7 of the playlist, docs/parity-video-findings.md) done in the port's physics at the pace of that video: 4 portals, 3 of 3 crystals, medal 3.

Built by hand from the footage in planning step 266, after the owner's report of 2026-11-20 that he could not copy it ('I am not jumping as high as in the original and I am going down too fast so I do not even have time to destroy the red cog').

P0 (tick 44, (316,147)): a portal on the left face of the block cluster. P1 (tick 150, (258,235)): a portal in the pit under the diamond (the player stands at the edge, x 235, when he shoots it in this play; from x 216 the shot is stopped by the platform's corner; where the footage's player stands is only known to be near the edge).

He steps off the edge (hold right 200), falls into P1 (the diamond of the pit is taken on the way down, tick 216), and comes out of P0 going UP: tick 221, y 140 to an apex of 87 on tick 242, 40 ticks of 60 Hz (0.67 s; the footage: about 0.7 s, read by eye) before he lands.

The diamond over the block is taken on the way up (tick 222). A SHOT at the red cog (anti_portal_agent, (418,108)) fired from the air, ticks 228 to 252 (the cog dies 16 ticks later): a window of 25 ticks, 0.42 s. At the port's old pace (the file's 60) the same window is 13 ticks, 0.22 s, and the flight 22 ticks:

that is what he met. P2 (tick 280, (372,98)) over the block the ring covered, P3 (tick 312, (330,146)) in front of the face; into P3 and out of P2 onto the block, on over the bridge to the third diamond (618,144) and the rocket.
Replayed and must win with medal 3 (TheGoldRoutesEarnGold); nobody has done it by hand on a phone.
